body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{KL}}\) with the fixed thresholds and one joint multiplier decision rule in its construction, does the pass event \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{KL}}\) occur for at least one preregistered observable stratum of \(\mathscr D_{\mathrm{KL}}\)?
body.justification: The fixed familywise gate makes empirical usability, rather than symbolic identification alone, the unresolved kill test for the named six-period consumer.
body.gap: Kim and Lee report matching and cohort-time diagnostics but not a joint stopped-rank, HDK-residual, de-killing, frame-conditioning, cohort-support, gray-zone, and precision decision with preregistered thresholds.
body.consumer: A positive certificate would deliver the first directly usable hazard-lift analysis of Netflix adoption; universal rejection or gray-zone classification would honestly kill that application claim.
